content: prepareThreshold=0 is a documented PgJDBC-side workaround specifically for PgBouncer transaction-mode pooling not tracking server-side prepared statements per backend (fixed only in PgBouncer >=1.21 with max_prepared_statements set). With no PgBouncer/pooler in front of the database at all (direct connection), this rationale does not apply and PgJDBC's normal server-side prepared statement reuse (default threshold 5) can be enabled.
